title: My 2D asset pipeline, then the games using its output
author: softmarshmallow
selftext:
I'm building stage-gen, an open-source tool for generating 2D game assets. The clip starts with a run inspector, then shows generated art in runner and platformer demos.

I supply art direction and references in prepared packages. GPT Image 2 generates image assets with native transparency; stage-gen validates and assembles them. The gameplay rules are authored, and the graph is a read-only inspector. Generation uses your own API keys and provider billing.

If you've used generated sprites in a game, what took the most cleanup?

https://github.com/softmarshmallow/stage-gen
